C1.worst_defect: No 'who this is for / who should not use it' line and no comparison with Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed: the page goes from the 'What it does today' features straight to 'Live demo or your own store' and setup, so a shopper comparing tills cannot tell why they would pick a pre-release Vendure till

C2.worst_defect: Hero sells an 'open-source till', but 'Before you start' says 'you need your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)' to build it yourself, a paid licence in a bottom bullet with no price; separately the till role's missing ReadOrder is admitted only as 'Not in the release notes: in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder' and is still unpatched six weeks after the 2026-10-06 release
C2.where: home.desktop.02 'Setting up the store'; changelog.desktop.01 0.2.0 notes

C3.worst_defect: Optional device key step asks the reader to patch the plugin's own role: 'On plugin 0.3.0 the role it creates (vendurepos-pos-till) has the step 4 permissions except ReadOrder, so add ReadOrder to that role yourself'; a stray collapsible 'If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app' is left over from an older host
C3.where: quick-start desktop.03-04 'Optional: device key' and CORS step

C4.worst_defect: Limitations ('What VendurePOS does not do yet') omits two known 0.3.0 gaps documented elsewhere: the till role without ReadOrder (changelog) and 'On plugin 0.3.0, Order details has no customer note' (at-the-till)

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' mixes two boxed test-backed cards with a block of unboxed two-column plain features, so the hierarchy reads uneven; the 404 page is a mostly empty canvas

C6.worst_defect: Phone hero shows the till running in a phone layout, while Limitations says 'other browsers, tablets and phones (an iPad included) are not tested yet'; the screenshot is also cut mid-grid by the fold

C7.worst_defect: 404 page offers only Home, Docs and Live demo buttons, with no search box or Quick start link; Lighthouse notes minor 'unused-javascript' (~53 KiB)

overall_worst.defect: Hero calls it an 'open-source till', but building or hosting the till yourself needs a paid RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM), mentioned only in a bottom 'Before you start' bullet with no price or explanation
overall_worst.fix: In the hero or at the top of 'Before you start', say plainly: the till's source is MIT, building it yourself needs a commercial RxDB Premium licence (give the rough cost and a link), and app.vendurepos.com is the free hosted till that needs no licence
